reason: Installed TensorRT 8.6 lacks required >=10.15 native Attention/RotaryEmbedding, V3 plugin and runtime memory APIs. Published aarch64 wheel requires glibc 2.39 whereas this host has glibc 2.35. Official Orin release payload targets JetPack 7.2/CUDA 13; current host is L4T 36.3/CUDA 12.2.
null_meaning: Not measured because a native pi05 engine could not run. Null is neither zero nor a speed estimate; probe runtime and probe RSS are not engine measurements.
migration_claim: Current official release path is blocked; this does not prove that a separately engineered and validated source port is theoretically impossible.
